prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Greenvale Metro CBTC (peak/off-peak/engineering hours). Degraded: LTC declares when MA, localization, point detection, platform interface or radio untrusted (=loss of comms); trains stationary/controlled speed until separation restored. Triage: safety critical, service affecting, cyber, maintenance-only. Return to auto: stable comms, verified route, confirmed position, recorded handback; cyber controls prerequisite. Actors: Line Traffic Controller (LTC, OCC; holding/skip-stop/turnback via Lantern; produces Temporary Speed Restriction Notice; receives Route Release Exception List; manual route recovery; concurs with Maple on resets; notified of cyber events; may stop commissioning trials). Revenue Train Operator (acknowledgements/repeat-backs to Atlas; restricted manual; sends Test Train Clearance Memo to Lantern; commissioning-qualified crews test trains; no cyber admin). Signal Maintenance Engineer, alias Maple (Axle Counter Reset Request; remote read-only outside window; CSO approval). Cyber Security Officer (monitors Safety Data Communication Network, Saffron, Lantern; correlates events; uses audit file; approves sensitive permissions). Elements: Metro Operations Control System, alias Lantern (sends Crew Login Token Bundle to Atlas; never obscures alarms). Service Timetable Server, Passenger Information Gateway (monitored for compromise). Voice Dispatch Console (authorizes restricted manual moves; in cyber incident procedures). North District Zone Controller, alias Marble (East Junction; applies TSR Notice); South District Zone Controller, alias Orchid (West Junction); both send MA. East Junction Interlocking, alias Falcon (sends Axle Counter Reset Request; rejects bad signature/expired cert/out-of-window). West Junction Interlocking (sends Route Release Exception List); both interlockings enhanced monitoring during migration. Atlas Onboard Controller, alias Kestrel (Brake Curve Checksum Log). Dual Channel Odometer. Train Radio Modem (reports safe-data loss to Atlas). Wayside Radio Access Network, alias Saffron. Maintenance Diagnostic Server (can't alter MA). Quarry (alias; tags sessions with incident ID). Platform Screen Door Controller (only authenticated approved interfaces). Cryptographic Key Management Appliance (issues certificates to Atlas, Modem, Marble, Orchid, West Junction Interlocking). Reqs: audit records protected from generator alteration, retained per governance; Odometer/Atlas diagnostics without exposing crypto; responsibility review after major changes/incidents. Commissioning: baseline config-checked vs approved release record; non-passenger test trains, restricted speed until Atlas+Marble stable; Orchid

New part:
S233: Metro Operations Control System uses the status snapshot to confirm that platform interface conditions are suitable before authorizing the associated commissioning scenario.
S234: The Platform Screen Door Controller shall be included in end-to-end tests that confirm safe coordination between platform equipment, train stopping position, and supervised door enablement.
S235: The Service Timetable Server shall provide trial schedules that exercise normal headways, recovery margins, terminal reversals, and junction conflicts without carrying passengers.
S236: The Passenger Information Gateway shall be observed during operational rehearsal to confirm that public-facing messages remain consistent with the planned commissioning condition.
S237: Voice Dispatch Console procedures shall be rehearsed for test-train dispatch, abnormal stop instructions, evacuation coordination, and return to depot instructions.
S238: The Maintenance Diagnostic Server shall collect commissioning diagnostics so that intermittent radio, odometry, controller, and interlocking events can be reviewed before acceptance.
S239: The Cryptographic Key Management Appliance shall be confirmed as available, synchronized with the approved security baseline, and capable of supporting commissioning operations without manual workarounds.
S240: Readiness reviews shall be held at the completion of each stage and shall include representatives from operations, signalling maintenance, rolling stock, communications, safety assurance, and cyber security.
S241: A Signal Maintenance Engineer shall verify that field defects raised during test running have been closed, deferred with approved controls, or assigned to a post-commissioning monitoring plan.
S242: A Cyber Security Officer shall confirm that access controls, event monitoring, operator accounts, and security incident escalation paths are effective before revenue operation is recommended.
S243: Operational rehearsal shall use realistic degraded scenarios including radio coverage loss, failed train initialization, controller switchover, interlocking unavailability, and control center workstation failure.
S244: The rehearsal shall demonstrate that the Line Traffic Controller can maintain safe service regulation while the Revenue Train Operator follows onboard indications and rulebook instructions.
S245: Acceptance for revenue service shall require completion of planned test cases, closure of safety-critical defects, successful rollback demonstration, and approval of the operations readiness record.
S246: No open defect shall be accepted for revenue service unless its operational restriction, maintenance response, and passenger impact have been assessed and approved by the readiness review authority.
S247: Final entry into revenue service shall occur only after management confirms that training, documentation, staffing, spare equipment, monitoring arrangements, and emergency procedures are in place for sustained operation.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
